# Spinnaker Support

> Spinnaker Support provides trusted third-party support and expert services for enterprise software including Oracle, SAP, JD Edwards, and VMware with proactive security, AI-assisted issue resolution, and cost optimization.

Spinnaker Support specializes in vendor-independent enterprise software support, offering break-fix services, managed services, and proprietary tools like Spinnaker Shield, Spinnaker Intelligence, and Spinnaker Link. The company serves global enterprises seeking cost reduction, security compliance, and technical expertise beyond vendor support.

## Key Topics

- Third-party support
- Oracle support
- SAP support
- Break-fix services
- Managed services
- Security and vulnerability management
- Cost savings and cost reduction
- Enterprise software support
- AI-assisted issue resolution
- Cloud migration
- Vendor independence
- Technical advisory
- Tax compliance
- JD Edwards
- VMware

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Spinnaker Support Homepage](https://www.spinnakersupport.com): Enterprise software support for Oracle, SAP & VMware with trusted third-party expertise.
- [Third-Party Support Overview](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/third-party-support): Main third-party support service overview for Oracle, SAP, JDE and enterprise software.
- [Expert Services](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/expert-services): Ongoing & project-based expert services for Oracle, SAP, JD Edwards with managed services and infrastructure support.

## Proprietary Products & Platforms

- [Spinnaker Shield](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/spinnaker-shield): Proactive full-stack security & vulnerability protection with risk mitigation for enterprise software.
- [Spinnaker Intelligence](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/spinnaker-intelligence): AI-assisted issue resolution tool for faster issue identification in enterprise software.
- [Spinnaker Link](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/spinnaker-link): Interoperability services for the IT ecosystem managing Oracle, JD Edwards and cross-platform integrations.

## Oracle Support Services

- [Oracle Support Hub](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle): Trusted third-party Oracle support covering Agile PLM, ATG Web Commerce, Endeca and more.
- [Oracle Database Support](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle/third-party-support/oracle-database-support): 24/7 Oracle Database third-party support with security patching and maintenance.
- [Oracle Fusion Middleware Support](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle/third-party-support/oracle-fusion-middleware): Oracle Fusion Middleware and E-Business Suite third-party support services.
- [Oracle Hyperion Support](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle/third-party-support/oracle-hyperion): Global Oracle Hyperion financial planning third-party support with 62% cost savings.
- [Oracle Siebel CRM Support](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle/third-party-support/oracle-siebel-crm): Standard Oracle Siebel CRM support for Sales, Analytics and compliance.
- [Oracle PeopleSoft Support](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle/third-party-support/oracle-peoplesoft): Oracle PeopleSoft HCM third-party support with break-fix and compliance services.
- [Oracle Agile PLM Support](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle/oracle-agile-plm): Oracle Agile PLM third-party support with break-fix and compliance services.
- [Oracle ATG Web Commerce & Endeca Support](https://www.spinnakersupport.com/oracle/oracle-atg-web-commerce-endeca): Oracle ATG Web Commerce and Endeca third-party support and services.
